answer: Farming becomes a nectar bet on surviving 113 epochs of grading, and every pearl settlement recomputes the garden schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 113 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 35 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
